answer: The terrace is cut into the bank below the river, one landing deeper for every signal an operator keeps running, since two marked streams cannot run side by side and an identity drinks only its own mark. The river silts every cut by epoch's end; undredged, that identity's signal stops and it acts no more. An operator running a thousand signals dredges a thousand cuts, the deepest a thousand landings long: half a million barrels of silt a season, against one barrel for a newcomer.
